case_summary: A threat actor used a fake Zoom installer to deploy d3f@ckloader and IDAT loader, which dropped SectopRAT. After nine days of dwell time, the threat actor deployed Cobalt Strike and Brute Ratel for lateral movement and credential access. Finally, BlackSuit ransomware was executed across all Windows systems.
source_title: Fake Zoom Ends in BlackSuit Ransomware - The DFIR Report
